title: Label Ensemble Perspective for Reduced-Complexity Graph Node Classification under Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2411.11020v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely employed for semi-supervised node classification tasks on graphs. However, the performance of GNNs is significantly affected by \emph{label noise}, that is, a small amount of incorrectly labeled nodes can substantially misguide model training. Mainstream solutions define node classification with label noise (NCLN) as a reliable labeling task, often introducing node similarity with quadratic computational complexity to more accurately assess label reliability. To this end, in this paper, we introduce the Label Ensemble Graph Neural Network (LEGNN), a lower complexity method for robust GNNs training against label noise. LEGNN reframes NCLN as a label ensemble task, gathering informative multiple labels instead of constructing a single reliable label, avoiding high-complexity computations for reliability assessment. translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）已被广泛应用于图上的半监督节点分类任务。然而，GNN的性能会受到标签噪声的显著影响，即少量被错误标注的节点就可能严重误导模型训练。主流解决方案将带标签噪声的节点分类（NCLN）定义为一个可靠标注任务，通常引入具有二次计算复杂度的节点相似度来更准确地评估标签可靠性。为此，本文提出了标签集成图神经网络（LEGNN），这是一种复杂度更低、能够抵抗标签噪声实现GNN鲁棒训练的方法。LEGNN将NCLN重新构建为一个标签集成任务，收集信息丰富的多个标签，而不是构建单一可靠标签，从而避免了高复杂度的可靠性评估计算。具体而言，LEGNN执行一个两步过程：自举相邻节点的……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出LEGNN方法，将带标签噪声的节点分类问题重新建模为标签集成任务，通过聚合多个信息丰富的标签而非构建单一可靠标签，避免了高复杂度的可靠性评估计算，实现了抗标签噪声且复杂度更低的GNN鲁棒训练。
